mode.title: Mode
mode.description: games = one row per finished game with its closing line and how each market settled. teams = one row per team with straight up and against the spread records. summary = one row per league showing how often favourites won, covered and went over.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, ncaaf, ncaab, wnba, epl, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, mls, ucl, uel. A raw ESPN path such as football/nfl also works.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days of finished games to grade, counting back from today. Ignored when a start date is given.

dateFrom.title: Start date (optional)
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Grade a fixed range instead of the last few days, e.g. a whole season month. Past seasons work too.

dateTo.title: End date (optional)
dateTo.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the start date, so leaving it empty grades a single day.

teamFilter.title: Team filter (optional)
teamFilter.description: Keep only games involving these teams, by abbreviation or name, e.g. NYY, Lakers. Empty returns every game.

onlyUpsets.title: Only upsets
onlyUpsets.description: Keep only games the underdog won outright at the closing moneyline.

minClosingSpread.title: Minimum closing spread
minClosingSpread.description: Keep only games where the closing spread was at least this many points, e.g. 7 for clear mismatches. 0 = no limit.

maxGames.title: Max games to grade
maxGames.description: Cap on how many finished games are looked up, newest first. Each game is one request, so this is the main speed and cost lever.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned after grading and filtering. Controls total cost.
